name: pando-repo
description: Repo tooling for projects/pando: lint (oxlint with the vendored anti-slop plugin, tools/oxlint/anti-slop) and Effect's source for agents to read. npm workspaces: web and packages/*; worker/ keeps its own install until it joins.

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings worker/src worker/test agents/src agents/test web packages site/docs/astro.config.ts site/docs/scripts site/docs/src
